verdict.rationale: First-party docs show a single SDK call (`sandbox = daytona.create()`) that returns a ready sandbox for immediate command execution. Each sandbox is isolated with its own kernel, filesystem and network stack. Daytona claims spin-up in milliseconds and documents warm pools that hand out pre-created sandboxes instantly; Python and TypeScript SDKs and a published OpenAPI spec back the programmatic path. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the startup-latency claims (the speed evidence is vendor marketing only).
